events.title: La Oreja de Van Gogh at Starlite Occident Marbella
events.summary: La Oreja de Van Gogh are confirmed for Starlite Occident Marbella on Friday, 13 August 2027 at 22:00. The official Starlite page frames the show as part of the band's new era with Amaia Montero returning and its 30-year milestone.
